topic: SP-027 security audit lows and accepted limits
detail: From two security-audit rounds on the relabel (all medium findings fixed): (1) orchd's local log line for a source the placer could not place includes the placer's error, which can name its source URI (orchd's log already names paths elsewhere); (2) the stale-source list per collection is held in memory, one entry per source, and a source is moved whole: fine at 40,000 chunks, unbounded in principle; (3) a hand-off chunk stored without an origin is placed by the path it was edited at; a process that can write there could swap a link for a file before the relabel (documented in docs/internals/memory.md); (4) the report names spaces, so the planned Relabel RPC must be operator-only; (5) chunks with a stored origin reuse the visibility recorded at write time.
